title: Price Promise Basis: The Window and the Competing Price on a Northbeam Purchase Order
content:
A lower advertised price is matched on an order under Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment only within the
fulfilment service's price match window, counted from the day the order was placed. The window is counted in calendar
days from the day the order was placed, which counts as day zero, and that day is the day standing on the retailer's
own record of the order rather than the day the customer says they bought. The window is met by equality: a request
falling on the last day of the window is within it.

The price is matched only against a source the fulfilment service accepts, for the identical model in stock and
available to buy from that seller, and never against the sales the fulfilment service excludes.

## The four conditions of a match

| Condition | What it requires |
| --- | --- |
| the window | the request falls no later than the last day of the service's window, counted from the day the order was placed as day zero |
| the source | the competing price comes from a source the fulfilment service accepts |
| the model | the competing price is for the identical model, in stock and available to buy from that seller |
| the sale | the competing price is not one of the sales the fulfilment service excludes |

## The window counted out (hypothetical days)

On a service whose window stands at 15 days, the day the order was placed is day zero; a request on day 15 falls
within the window, and a request on day 16 falls after it. On a service whose window stands at 30 days the same
counting makes day 30 the last day within the window.

## Points of judgement

**Is a lower price at a seller who has the model on back order matched?** The condition is that the identical model is
in stock and available to buy from that seller.

**Is a clearance price matched?** Not where clearance stands among the sales the fulfilment service excludes.

**From what day does the window run?** From the day the order was placed, which counts as day zero.
